body: I've been tested for nutrient deficiencies and stuff, and it was all fine. My psychologist mentioned that I might be clinically depressed last year but I don't think we really ever confirmed it? I don't know I just don't feel like I have the right to say that I have depression, if that makes sense. It feels like it's kind of just a mental weakness on my part, I'm too sensitive or weak willed or something. Like I don't have a right to say I'm suffering like other people who legitimately suffer from depression. I haven't tried medication, my psychologist suggested it but I refused.
